name: Metronidazole
summary: A key anaerobic and protozoal agent whose usefulness is matched by its classic alcohol and neuropathy cautions.
good: Anaerobic coverage and certain protozoal infections.
bad: Unreviewed warfarin use or poor adherence to alcohol avoidance.
clinicalPearls: It is a strong anaerobe drug because anaerobes activate it best.
mechanism: Reduced in anaerobic organisms to reactive metabolites that damage DNA.
indications: Anaerobic infections, bacterial vaginosis, trichomoniasis, and selected GI/dental infections.
interactionNotes: Warfarin interaction and alcohol avoidance are the practical classics.

warnings: Alcohol reaction, metallic taste, GI upset, and peripheral neuropathy with prolonged use.
